meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 不再自己动手,而是当编排者:派子代理按阶段执行计划,每阶段先派实施代理,再派验证、反模式检查、代码质量审查代理,全部通过后才派提交代理提交。
howto.when: 当你要求执行、运行或落实某份计划时触发,尤其是 make-plan 生成的计划。

say.text: 按这份计划执行第一阶段
say.note: 先派实施代理,再派验证代理跑检查清单

say.text: 继续下一阶段,先同步工作分支
say.note: 分支同步代理推送后,才启动新阶段

say.text: 验证没通过就不要提交代码
say.note: 验证通过才派提交代理

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an orchestrator: instead of doing the work itself, it deploys subagents to execute a phased plan — implementation, then verification, anti-pattern and code-quality checks, and a commit subagent only if verification passes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to execute, run, or carry out a plan, especially one created by make-plan.

say_en.text: Move on to the next phase and sync the branch
say_en.note: Branch/sync subagent pushes, then next phase starts
Commit subagent runs only after verification passes
